narr: A complex of strong to severe thunderstorms formed along and ahead of a pre-front trough axis that move along a stalled front well to our north on June 6th. Most of the severe storms occurred in near and east of the I-65 corridor.
ev: The road was washed out due to flash flooding at CR 97 at CR 930. Depth of water was 8 to 10 inches rushing over the road.
